animations.description: animate the working shimmer: full | subtle | off

intro.description: play the startup intro on attach (force --no-intro skips one attach)

icons.description: icon tier: auto (by terminal) | on (Nerd Font symbols) | off

staleAfterHours.description: after how many idle hours an unseen session is stale

unreadReplies.description: turn a working session's icon blue when it wrote you something you have not seen

autoUpgradeSessions.description: restart idle outdated agent sessions automatically

autoUpgradeIdleMinutes.description: how long an outdated session must be idle to auto-upgrade

layout.description: split (ui tmux per terminal) | classic (one tmux)

opencodeManaged.description: keep Force's own OpenCode copy on the latest release

checkForUpdates.description: check once a day whether a newer Force exists

notifyCommand.description: command run when a session needs you, finishes or stops ($FORCE_MESSAGE, $FORCE_EVENT, …)

notifyWhenViewed.description: also notify about a session a terminal is showing

supportAgent.description: the agent Chuck, the support assistant, runs on: auto | claude | opencode

supportModel.description: Chuck's model: Claude Code an alias or id (opus, sonnet), OpenCode provider/model (any provider it knows)

crashRestartMax.description: how often a session is restarted after a crash

crashWindowMinutes.description: the crash window those restarts count in

startGraceSeconds.description: how long a session may stay down before a restart counts

richTerminals.description: terminals that get the rich icons in auto mode (a regex)

introCellAspect.description: intro cell height/width when the terminal reports no pixel size (0 = automatic)

reloadOnChange.description: reload code and config changes without restarting the daemon
